title: Games
summary: A growing arcade of original browser games built from scratch — Ghostpile (a chain-letter dodge run), Sorta (a daily deduction puzzle), Tabfish (an idle tab-bar fishing game), Askew and more. All playable instantly, no sign-ups.

title: Plumb
summary: Does your building stack up? Drop the DWG or DXF floor plans you already have and Plumb lines every floor up on the one below, then finds what 2D drawings hide between sheets: floating columns, columns that jog, toilets over bedrooms, ducts and lift wells that shift, deep cantilevers. Registration-colour overlay with the drawing's own dimensions, a 3D X-ray stack, and a full 3D building model (section cut, storey heights, .glb export) — plus markups DXF back to CAD, a printable report and optional Claude assist.

title: Pivot
summary: Will your sofa fit? Describe the item and every door, hallway, stair flight and lift on the way in — Pivot solves the real 3D “piano mover’s problem” in your browser, animates the exact moves (stand it on its arm, hook it round the frame…), names the tightest centimetre, and tests fixes when it won’t go.

title: Groundtruth
summary: A satellite time machine for India's megaprojects — swipe, lens and blink through every satellite capture since 2010 of 33 sites (Navi Mumbai Airport, Atal Setu, Chenab Bridge, Khavda…), or scan any spot on Earth. Real capture dates, milestone timelines, 3D terrain, measuring, a watchlist that flags new imagery, and MP4 timelapse export.

title: India Infra Atlas
summary: A living map of India's infrastructure, tech, energy & defense news — daily auto-updating pins and corridors on a full interactive map with 3D terrain, rail overlays, measuring tools and a timeline.

title: India Energy Atlas
summary: Interactive maps of India's oil, gas, coal, solar & wind — reserves, production, import dependency, frontier exploration, field depths, costs and feasibility, with live charts.

title: Diff Checker
summary: Advanced text comparison with analytics, history, and file upload (PDF, DOCX, code), plus formatting for JSON, Python, JavaScript and SQL.

title: WordGen
summary: Rewrite anything: paraphrase, fix grammar, change tone, turn rough notes into a better LLM prompt, restyle text as an email, LinkedIn/WhatsApp/Instagram post or tweet, and swap single words for context-aware synonyms. Free offline engine or bring your own API key (Claude, OpenAI-compatible, custom). Ships with a sticky-note Chrome extension.

title: JWT Decoder
summary: Decode and encode JSON Web Tokens with algorithm support and signature verification — a clean jwt.io-style tool.
